messages:
Marta (Acme): Hey team — since the morning rollout our assistant is giving much shorter, overly-safe answers. Example: previously it would provide an implementation sketch for a regex-based parser; now it replies ‘I can't help with that’. This started around 09:12 PDT after you pushed something. Can you check?

Priya (Support): Sorry about that, Marta. Can you paste a minimal failing request (payload + model name)? Also which API endpoint are you calling (chat vs text-gen) and do you have a request timestamp?

Marta (Acme): Sure — we call POST /v1/chat with model "redwood-chat-1". Here is a redacted request body we use in prod: ```json
{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "How to implement a regex for email splitting?"}], "max_tokens": 200}
``` Previously returned a helpful code sketch. Now returns: "I'm sorry, I can't assist with that." No explicit error.

Priya (Support): Copying infra and oncall: @Liam @Carlos — customer reports behavior drift after deploy. No 5xxs, just different outputs. Can you confirm any config changes to sampling defaults? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment v3.14.0 to production started at 2026-03-15T16:50:22Z. Release notes: "sampling profiles: introduce safe_sampling_v2 as default for public chat models"

Liam (Infra): I see the release note. Investigating if default sampling params changed. Pinging CI logs.

qa-bot: Canary tests flagged increased determinism for chat model redwood-chat-1 at 16:52Z: entropy drop -18% vs baseline.

Liam (Infra): Found the rollout config (k8s ConfigMap): ```yaml
models:
  redwood-chat-1:
    sampling_profile: safe_sampling_v2
profiles:
  safe_sampling_v2:
    temperature: 0.0
    top_p: 0.0
    typical_p: 0.9
```
That looks suspect — safe_sampling_v2 sets both temperature and top_p to 0.0 which forces greedy/deterministic output. Older profile safe_sampling_v1 had temperature: 0.7, top_p: 0.95.

Carlos (SRE): Who merged that change? Checking Git history... PR #2783 changed default profile mapping. Author: infra-team. Approver: infra-lead. Timestamp matches today's deploy.

Priya (Support): Marta — TL;DR: we rolled a new default sampling profile that inadvertently disables sampling. Quick workaround: you can override per-request by adding "temperature": 0.7 (or desired value) in the request body. Example: ```json
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"How to implement a regex for email splitting?"}], "temperature": 0.7, "max_tokens": 200}
```

Marta (Acme): Thanks — adding temperature in the request restores previous behavior for us. Is there a plan to roll back the default? We can't change all client apps immediately.

Liam (Infra): We can hotfix the ConfigMap to revert the default sampling_profile for redwood-chat-1 to safe_sampling_v1. Will prepare a rollback patch.

Carlos (SRE): Rolling back in 10m. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot to do a fast rollback. Also opening incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for deployment v3.14.0 -> restoring sampling_profile to safe_sampling_v1 for redwood-chat-1. Rollback window: 16:58Z-17:05Z.

Liam (Infra): Patch applied and propagated to all replicas. Verified live config: ```yaml
models:
  redwood-chat-1:
    sampling_profile: safe_sampling_v1
```
QA: re-running canary...

qa-bot: Canary checks at 17:02Z show entropy back to baseline ±2%. Functional test: sample user prompt returns code sketch as before.

Priya (Support): Marta — we rolled back the change. Can you confirm your production traffic is back to expected behavior? If you want we can also run a sweep to detect any other models impacted.

Marta (Acme): Confirmed — behavior restored. Thanks for the fast turnaround. We'll keep an eye but very relieved.

Liam (Infra): Root cause summary for internal follow-up: a new "safe_sampling_v2" profile was introduced with more aggressive safety defaults (temperature/top_p set to 0.0). It was mistakenly set as default for redwood-chat-1 in the release PR. Next steps: 1) revert PR for default mapping; 2) add CI gate that fails if both temperature and top_p are 0.0 for profiles assigned to public models; 3) publish rollout note and customer comms.

Carlos (SRE): Filing post-incident action items: INCIDENT-2026-0315-01. Will assign owners: infra-team for PR revert, product for comms, support for customer outreach.

Priya (Support): Marta — we'll follow up with a short incident summary and a permanent mitigation plan. Apologies for the disruption and thanks for the quick repro.

Marta (Acme): Appreciate it. Please cc our security/compliance too since we had to push a temporary client change.

Priya (Support): Will do. Closing initial thread but keeping incident open until postmortem published. :white_check_mark:
